verses.1:
Give thanks to the LORD, for He is good;
 His loving devotion endures forever.
verses.2:
Let Israel + 118:2 LXX the house of Israel say,
 “His loving devotion endures forever.”
verses.3:
Let the house of Aaron say,
 “His loving devotion endures forever.”
verses.4:
Let those who fear the LORD say,
 “His loving devotion endures forever.”
verses.5:
In my distress I called to the LORD,
 and He answered and set me free.
verses.6:
The LORD is on my side; + 118:6 Or The LORD is with me ; also in verse 7; LXX The Lord is my helper I will not be afraid.
 What can man do to me? + 118:6 Cited in Hebrews 13:6|HEB 13:6
verses.7:
The LORD is on my side; He is my helper.
 Therefore I will look in triumph on those who hate me.
verses.8:
It is better to take refuge in the LORD
 than to trust in man.
verses.9:
It is better to take refuge in the LORD
 than to trust in princes.
verses.10:
All the nations surrounded me,
 but in the name of the LORD I cut them off.
verses.11:
They surrounded me on every side,
 but in the name of the LORD I cut them off.
verses.13:
I was pushed so hard I was falling,
 but the LORD helped me.
verses.14:
The LORD is my strength and my song,
 and He has become my salvation.
verses.15:
Shouts of joy and salvation resound in the tents of the righteous:
 “The right hand of the LORD performs with valor!
verses.16:
The right hand of the LORD is exalted!
 The right hand of the LORD performs with valor!”
verses.17:
I will not die, but I will live
 and proclaim what the LORD has done.
verses.18:
The LORD disciplined me severely,
 but He has not given me over to death.
verses.19:
Open to me the gates of righteousness,
 that I may enter and give thanks to the LORD.
verses.20:
This is the gate of the LORD;
 the righteous shall enter through it.
verses.21:
I will give You thanks, for You have answered me,
 and You have become my salvation.
verses.22:
The stone the builders rejected
 has become the cornerstone. + 118:22 Hebrew the head of the corner ; cited in Matthew 21:42|MAT 21:42 , Mark 12:10, Luke 20:17, Acts 4:11, and 1 Peter 2:7
verses.23:
This is from the LORD,
 and it is marvelous in our eyes. + 118:23 Cited in Matthew 21:42|MAT 21:42 and Mark 12:11
verses.24:
This is the day that the LORD has made;
 we will rejoice and be glad in it.
verses.25:
O LORD, save us, we pray. + 118:25 Hebrew hosia-na , meaning save, we pray or save now ; see Matthew 21:9|MAT 21:9 , Matthew 21:15, Mark 11:9, and John 12:13. 
 We beseech You, O LORD, cause us to prosper!
verses.26:
Blessed is he who comes in the name of the LORD. + 118:26 Cited in Matthew 21:9|MAT 21:9 , Matthew 23:39, Mark 11:9, Luke 13:35, Luke 19:38, and John 12:13 
 From the house of the LORD we bless you.
verses.27:
The LORD is God;
 He has made His light to shine upon us.
 Bind the festal sacrifice with cords
 to the horns of the altar. + 118:27 Or Join in the festal procession with boughs in hand, up to the horns of the altar.
verses.28:
You are my God, and I will give You thanks.
 You are my God, and I will exalt You.
verses.29:
Give thanks to the LORD, for He is good;
 His loving devotion endures forever.
